truthfulness_note: content renders AcceptedSettlementInProcess as disposition=in_progress: the chip uses the PROGRESS variant (secondary-container, clock glyph) not a success tick, and no visible string says sent/complete/successful. This is TC-PSTAT-002 — the regression an Accepted*-prefix shortcut would cause.
refresh_note: Refresh is visible because in_progress is non-terminal. On terminal_success and terminal_failure it must be HIDDEN (TC-PSTAT-003 / TC-PSTAT-007).
error_note: OBIE returns not-found as 400 U011, not 404, so the mapping keys on the code. No Retry — the resource does not exist (TC-PSTAT-008).
